name: Stammy's Steel
old_description: As an experienced welder and engineer, I have extensive experience and specialized know-how. I believe what really sets me apart from the rest of the industry is my attention to detail and ability to cater to the unique needs of each client.
about:
Stammy's Steel was founded in 2012 in Oakdale, Connecticut by a welder and engineer whose background in nuclear engineering and passion for motorsports led to a fabrication business. The owner began by building custom off-road parts for a trophy truck project and later expanded into the local drifting scene.

The shop provides welding, repairs, and fabrication services, including precision cutting, roll cage fabrication, and metal bending. All bending and welding are performed in-house to control quality and cost. The company also offers mobile welding and repair services across the greater New England region, equipped for plasma cutting and gouging.

Stammy's Steel serves motorsports enthusiasts, off-road vehicle builders, automotive clients, and industrial equipment operators. Customers range from drift teams needing roll cages to facilities requiring large equipment repairs and one-off custom projects.

The founder emphasizes attention to detail and the ability to tailor solutions to each client's unique needs as the core differentiators. The business grew from a reputation for integrity and broad construction knowledge, aiming to deliver bespoke fabrication that cannot be sourced off the shelf.
